known_issues: Text color changes made inside “+ Add Prompt” do not persist after clicking Save; prompts revert to black (including in search view).

existing_features.title: Ensure prompt text color formatting set in the “Add Prompt” rich-text editor persists after clicking Save by preserving and/or normalizing color markup during HTML sanitization (including browser-generated <font color="..."> and equivalent inline color styles) so the saved prompt content retains the selected colors.

Display the persisted per-prompt text color formatting consistently wherever prompt content is rendered (including search-filtered results), ensuring no view path re-sanitizes in a way that strips colors.

new_feature_requests.summary: Persist each prompt’s custom text color after saving and display it consistently (e.g., in search results)
